inputs: All eight acquired current FLT SCI WCS headers, no SCI/ERR/DQ array values. Primary SUBARRAY=F/FULLIMAG, SCI LTV1=LTV2=0, LTM diagonal=1, dimensions1014x1014; verify independently before comparison.
grid_rule: Cartesian product, 121 positions per FLT; center=(507,507). Map array coordinate is FITS x/y converted to zero-based array index (y-1,x-1) if PAM is 1014x1014. If PAM is 1024x1024, use official five-pixel border rule only if header/source identifies orientation; otherwise stop numeric comparison.
jacobian: Spherical solid-angle determinant from native FLT SCI TAN-SIP WCS world unit-vector finite differences in x/y, absolute; normalize to its value at center. Compare official PAM grid values normalized to PAM at same center, no free scaling/fitting. Retain each FLT independently, max and median absolute relative discrepancy and half-step derivative change.
orientation_checks: Compare declared (y-1,x-1) PAM array indexing to WCS Jacobian; alternative transposes/flips may be computed only as labelled diagnostic, never selected to replace declared primary mapping.
photometric_direction: Per official WFC3 Data Handbook 9.1.2, multiply FLT count-rate image by PAM for point-source aperture photometry; DRZ is already area-corrected. Do not perform photometry in this task.
